raj: quick scan. main asks: small inline bench summary (public approx), explicit "streaming: supported" flag, and fix the broken anchor to sequence limits after the nav reorg.

```
Orpheus14b-q5_0 (1xA100):
- 512 tokens: p50 62ms, p95 150ms
```

taylor: add a short note under compatibility: q5_0 uses a mixed-kernel layout; CPU fallback is partial and may return degraded outputs. recommend customers use the bf16 build for CPU-only routes.
emma: added compatibility section: "Partial CPU fallback only; for full CPU fallback use orpheus14b-bf16" and a short explanation of mixed-kernel caveats.
marco: SDK snippets: please show v3 -> v4 migration and include both Python v4 and a Node one-liner. also update any old client.generate() examples.
emma: added migration snippet. Python v4 minimal example:
```
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.text.generate(model="orpheus14b-q5_0", input="Summarize: ...")
print(resp.output_text)
```
marco: add a REST curl example for route config prefix-caching and a note about default TTL (300s).
emma: added under Performance Tips:
```
# enable prefix cache
POST /v1/routes/my-route/config
{
  "prefix_cache": true,
  "max_cached_tokens": 8192,
  "cache_ttl_seconds": 300
}
```
